subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` threshold that lets operator check-mode gates ignore lower-severity secrets-audit findings while still reporting them?
rationale: The implementation is clean and default-compatible, but deciding whether lower-severity secrets-audit findings may be ignored by automation is a security-boundary policy choice.
